name: A Watchful Eye
summary: Theocritus watches Morganth from the Tower of Azora in Elwynn Forest. He sends travelers east into Redridge Mountains to place an enchanted glyph at an old lion statue near the Tower of Ilgalar.

sections.title: A Rivalry Across the Border
sections.body: Theocritus watches the hills from his tower in eastern Elwynn Forest. His rival, Morganth, is a powerful sorcerer who has claimed the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge Mountains. Theocritus fears Morganth's dark magic may cross the border, so he made the Eye of Azora to watch the rogue wizard from afar.

sections.title: The Lion's Vigil
sections.body: Theocritus needs more than a distant view to learn what Morganth plans. He gives travelers the Glyph of Azora and sends them to the Old Lion Statue near the Tower of Ilgalar. The statue has kept watch there for decades. Set the glyph into the worn hollow at its base, and an arcane link reaches back to Azora, letting Theocritus look into his rival's mind.

faq.answer: Theocritus is an Alliance wizard who lives in the Tower of Azora in eastern Elwynn Forest. He studies magic to guard the region from rogue spellcasters, especially Morganth.

Morganth is a rogue human wizard who has made the Tower of Ilgalar in Redridge Mountains his stronghold. He is Theocritus's bitter rival, and Theocritus fears the schemes he is making against the surrounding lands.

faq.q: Where is the Old Lion Statue located?
aliases: where to put glyph of azora
faq.answer: The Old Lion Statue stands on the ridges overlooking the Tower of Ilgalar in the eastern hills of Redridge Mountains. A shallow hollow at its base can hold the Glyph of Azora.

faq.q: What does the Glyph of Azora do?
faq.answer: The Glyph of Azora is an enchanted stone made by Theocritus. Set in the lion statue near the Tower of Ilgalar, it carries his arcane listening spell and lets him study Morganth's thoughts.

faq.q: What is the Tower of Ilgalar?
faq.answer: The Tower of Ilgalar is an isolated stone tower high in the crags of eastern Redridge Mountains. Morganth and his servants occupy and defend it.

faq.q: What comes after placing the glyph?
faq.answer: After the Glyph of Azora is set in the statue, Theocritus speaks through the stone and offers Looking Further. He begins to uncover Morganth's plans.

angles.text: As a mage, you see how arcane divination can reach across a great distance. Theocritus uses methods from Elwynn, while Morganth practices rogue sorcery.
As an Alliance member, you help guard the border between Elwynn Forest and the embattled settlements of Redridge Mountains from rogue human spellcasters like Morganth.
